question: A closed coil consists of $500$ turns on a rectangular frame of area $4.0 \text{ cm}^2$ and has a resistance of $50 \, \Omega$. The coil is kept with its plane perpendicular to a uniform magnetic field of $0.2 \text{ T}$. Calculate the amount of charge that flows through the coil if it is turned over (rotated by $180^\circ$).
